newsitem.title: USA: Johnston to close Valley, Alabama plant.
newsitem.headline: Johnston to close Valley, Alabama plant.

text.p: Johnston Industries Inc said Thursday it will close its Langdale plant in Valley, Alabama because it was old and had become a drain on earnings.
"The closure will enhance efficiency and result in substantial cost savings," it said in a statement.
The home furnishings and industrial textiles maker said it would convert the plant into a warehouse and distribution center for its fiber products division.
"This will allow the consolidation of several leased warehouse operations in the area," it said, adding that it expected the conversion to be complete by the end of the year.
It said it will eliminate the unprofitable outside sales yarn and relocate the equipment required for internal needs.
Johnston said the closure will affect about 320 of its 3,000 employees.

"While the company will not be able to relocate all of the displaced employees immediately, the continued expansion at Shawmut and other Johnston facilities will create future opportunities for a number of qualified employees," it said.
Its Shawmut Complex in Valley, Alabama finishes, inspects, and ships woven upholstery.
